weights.description: tensor names of the weights manifest: attention = by kind of the layer (linear_attention = Gated DeltaNet, full_attention), ffn = the feed-forward half of every layer

chain.description: HEAD = attention half of layer 0; BLOCK i (i = 0 .. N-2) = feed-forward half of layer i + attention half of layer i + 1, the graph of its KIND (plan.graphs[..].blocks[kind]); TAIL = feed-forward half of layer N-1 + final norm; lm_head. The kind of layer i is model.json layer_types[i].

block_groups.description: decode only: graphs.<variant>.decode.<max length>.block_groups[K] = the N - 1 BLOCKs cut into runs of K ([{first_block, blocks, key, graph}], the last run may be shorter), one graph per distinct sequence of kinds (key: the kinds joined by '-', l / f = linear / full attention). A group graph takes residual + attention_output of its first block and returns next_residual + next_attention_output of its last block. Block j (BLOCK first_block + j) has the prefix b<j>_: the weights of the feed-forward half of layer first_block + j and of the attention half of layer first_block + j + 1 and its state: b<j>_conv_state / b<j>_recurrent_state (linear attention), b<j>_past_key / _past_value / _staging_key / _staging_value (full attention). Outputs b<j>_new_conv_state / b<j>_new_recurrent_state / b<j>_updated_key / b<j>_updated_value = the spare tensors, to be swapped in. rope_cos / rope_sin / attention_mask / staging_rows_to_keep / staging_row_selector are shared by the full attention blocks. Prefill has no groups (prefill_blocks_per_graph = [1]).

per_layer_type_inputs.description: full attention layers: rope_cos / rope_sin [1,1,S,head_dim] / attention_mask (partial rotary: the head dims are permuted at packing time, see model.json rope + pack_qwen35.py)

state.description: linear attention (Gated DeltaNet) layers carry a state through the graphs instead of a KV cache: conv_state [1,3,conv_channels] and recurrent_state [1,v_heads,k_dim,v_dim] (float16) are inputs of the layer's attention half and come back as new_conv_state / new_recurrent_state (the runtime swaps a state tensor with its spare); zero at the start of a prompt. Prefill graphs (S > 1) take two controls: valid_mask [1,1,S,1] (0 for the pad rows of the left-padded last chunk: beta and g are zeroed, the pad rows do nothing to the state) and conv_perm [1,S+3,S+3] (a permutation matrix applied to [conv_state rows | chunk rows]: the pad rows move in front of the state rows; the identity for a full chunk). protocol.linear_prefill_controls() builds both.

kv_protocols.description: only the staged protocol, for the full attention layers (a Gated DeltaNet layer has no KV cache): prefill = chunks (the last one left-padded) updating the main caches; decode = the new row goes into a staging buffer, attention reads concat(main cache, staging), the flush graph moves the staging rows into the main cache every staging_rows steps.

prefill_planning: several chunk sizes: protocol plan_prefill() picks the chunk sequence of a prompt with the lowest sum of (fixed tokens + size); fixed tokens default 200

logits.note: argmax / sampling over the first `vocab` entries only

vision.description: the image tower in the NPUW-style split, one set of graphs per grid preset (grid = patches in height x width): HEAD (patches [N, patch_vector] -> hidden_states [1,N,hidden]: patch matmul + bias + the position embedding of the grid), BLOCK x depth (ONE graph, weights bound per layer: hidden_states -> next_hidden_states), MERGER (hidden_states -> image_embeds [1,N/4,out_hidden]). Patches are in merge-block order and in the (channel, temporal, kh, kw) order of the Conv3d kernel (protocol patchify). The external constants pos_embed (HEAD) and rope_cos / rope_sin (BLOCK) are the tensors of the manifest file with role vision_grid and this grid; the weights are the manifest files vision_head / vision_block (layer i) / vision_merger.
